study type: quantitative research with a posttest control group design
exposure: ambulation during the first stage of labor
cohort: 60 primiparous mothers with 37-42 weeks of gestation, single vertex presentation, and spontaneous onset of labor in 1-2 centimeters of cervical dilatation
finding: Ambulation during the first stage of labor was effective in improving labor outcomes, including earlier fetal descent and increased coordination of uterine contraction intensity and frequency.
